# Every Docker image the CI jobs in .github/workflows/tests.yml need from the
# Supabase CLI pinned there (SUPABASE_CLI_VERSION), under the exact name the CLI
# looks for locally. scripts/ci/supabase-images.sh seeds these from the GHCR
# mirror and the supabase-images action caches them, so `supabase start`,
# `supabase test db` and `supabase gen types` find every image already present
# and never pull from public.ecr.aws, whose quotas for anonymous clients (1 pull
# per second, 500GB a month) shared GitHub runner IPs keep exhausting.
#
# Bump this list in the same PR as SUPABASE_CLI_VERSION. When it is stale CI
# fails loudly instead of pulling: the "Verify Supabase images" step names any
# container image missing from here, and a command that runs a one-off image
# (gen types, test db) fails with a connection error because the workflow blocks
# both public.ecr.aws and ghcr.io, the mirror the CLI falls back to. The tags
# for a CLI version are in its source at the matching tag:
# apps/cli-go/pkg/config/templates/Dockerfile for the services and pg_prove,
# and packages/stack/src/versions.ts for the postgres-meta tag `gen types`
# uses (it differs from the Dockerfile's).

# supabase start
public.ecr.aws/supabase/postgres:17.6.1.140
public.ecr.aws/supabase/kong:2.8.1
public.ecr.aws/supabase/postgrest:v14.14
public.ecr.aws/supabase/gotrue:v2.192.0
public.ecr.aws/supabase/realtime:v2.112.1
public.ecr.aws/supabase/storage-api:v1.61.7
public.ecr.aws/supabase/mailpit:v1.30.2

# supabase test db (integration job)
public.ecr.aws/supabase/pg_prove:3.36

# supabase gen types typescript --local (app job, scripts/gen-db-types.sh)
public.ecr.aws/supabase/postgres-meta:v0.96.1
